title: Methyl-CpG Binding Protein 2 Reads Histone Methylation via an Aromatic Cage to Regulate Gene Expression and Chromatin Association
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MeCP2-MBD结构域通过芳香笼读取组蛋白甲基化修饰，结合分子对接与突变实验揭示其识别机制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但核心为蛋白-组蛋白互作，方法以实验为主，AI/物理模拟有限，对TF-DNA互作建模有间接启发。
abstract: Methyl-CpG binding protein 2 (MeCP2) is a DNA methylation reader, which is highly expressed in the central nervous system. Loss of function mutation of MeCP2, which impairs DNA binding, causes Rett syndrome, while gain of MeCP2 function causes MeCP2 duplication syndrome. MeCP2 functions as both transcription activator and repressor but its full range of activity remains largely unknown. Recent study suggests that beyond DNA binding, MBD domain of MeCP2 also interacts with methylated lysine residues on histone H3 tail. In this study we aimed to characterize the methyllysine binding pocket of MeCP2-MBD. Structural analysis reveals the presence of an aromatic cage formed by five residues, namely, W104, F132, Y141, F142, and F155, where the trimethyllysine of H3K27me3 binds, as confirmed in docking studies. Alanine substitution of these residues abolished binding of MeCP2-MBD with its reported ligand H3K27me3 in ITC and pull-down experiments. Genomic analysis of publicly available ChIP-seq data reveals that MeCP2 localizes with canonical histone methylation marks like H3K4me3, H3K9me3, H3K27me3 and H4K20me3 and regulate critical biological and cancer related pathways. Promoters of MeCP2 regulated genes, show signature of H3K4me3 and H3K27me3. In the genomic level, mutation of aromatic cage residue W104A, significantly reduced chromatin occupancy of MeCP2 as demonstrated by ChIP-qPCR experiments. Furthermore, our qRT-PCR experiment, shows that this aromatic cage dependent binding is necessary for regulating expression of MeCP2 target genes. Overall, our study establishes MeCP2 as a histone methylation reader and highlights the functional significance of its histone binding capacity in chromatin association and gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 甲基-CpG结合蛋白2（MeCP2）是一种DNA甲基化读取器，在中枢神经系统中高表达。MeCP2的功能缺失突变会损害DNA结合，导致Rett综合征，而MeCP2功能增强则引起MeCP2重复综合征。MeCP2兼具转录激活因子和抑制因子的功能，但其全部活性范围在很大程度上仍属未知。近期研究表明，除DNA结合外，MeCP2的MBD结构域还与组蛋白H3尾部的甲基化赖氨酸残基相互作用。在本研究中，我们旨在表征MeCP2-MBD的甲基赖氨酸结合口袋。结构分析揭示了由五个残基（即W104、F132、Y141、F142和F155）形成的芳香笼，H3K27me3的三甲基赖氨酸结合于此，这一点在对接研究中得到证实。这些残基的丙氨酸替换在ITC和pull-down实验中消除了MeCP2-MBD与其已知配体H3K27me3的结合。对公开可用的ChIP-seq数据进行基因组分析显示，MeCP2与典型的组蛋白甲基化标记如H3K4me3、H3K9me3、H3K27me3和H4K20me3共定位，并调控关键的生物学及癌症相关通路。MeCP2调控基因的启动子显示出H3K4me3和H3K27me3的特征。在基因组水平上，芳香笼残基W104A的突变显著降低了MeCP2的染色质占据率，这一点通过ChIP-qPCR实验得到证实。此外，我们的qRT-PCR实验表明，这种依赖芳香笼的结合对于调控MeCP2靶基因的表达是必需的。总体而言，我们的研究确立了MeCP2作为组蛋白甲基化读取器的角色，并强调了其组蛋白结合能力在染色质关联和基因调控中的功能重要性。
